products: Galvanised and galvalume steel (zinc and aluminium-zinc coated)

company.productNote: Products named in JSW Steel's 2025–26 integrated report. The steel business of Bhushan Power and Steel was moved on 27 March 2026 into a 50:50 joint venture with JFE Steel and is no longer part of JSW Steel's consolidated results. Pictures are annual-report photographs.
